posts.title: How can this be?
posts.description: I guess maybe he knew he was going to die young and there wasn't much he could do about it. He lived life. He was present for his kids. He was so kind and welcoming to everyone. Apparently his father passed away from a heart attack in his 40s. posts.title: I don't do cockroaches
posts.description: When I arrived at the office this morning, I immediatley noticed there was a dead cockroach next to my desk. And let me tell you, this motherfucker was huge. Biggest one I've seen in a long time. I've learned that a dead-looking cockroach is sometimes not-so-dead and a sure fire way to tell is to blow air on it. So that's what I did.
